forecast.generalSituationZh: 一股達強風程度的東北季候風會在今日逐漸影響廣東沿岸，週末期間該區風勢頗大。而受另一股強烈東北季候風影響，下週初至中期華南普遍晴朗及乾燥，氣溫顯著下降，內陸地區早上清涼，日夜溫差較大。預料高空擾動會在下週後期為華南帶來有雨的天氣。
forecast.generalSituationEn: A strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong gradually today. It will be windy over the region during the weekend. Under the influence of another surge of intense northeast monsoon, the weather will be generally fine and dry with temperatures falling appreciably over southern China early to midweek next week. It will be cool in the morning over inland areas, and the temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. Upper-air disturbances are expected to bring rainy weather to southern China in the latter part of next week.
